entries.reasoning: AtliQ Inc offers rates for Senior Data Engineer ($72), Data Engineer ($55), and BI Developer ($50) to Lakeshore Grocers for data engineering and BI services that are lower than the rates committed under crestline (§6.4) while crestline's MFN pricing clause remains live through 31 July 2027.

incomingClauses.quote: Time-and-materials work, change orders and any additional SOWs shall be charged at the rates set out in the Rate Card, which shall remain fixed for the first twenty-four (24) months of this Agreement.
Rates are inclusive of all overheads. Offshore and onshore personnel are charged at the same rates. Rates apply to change orders and any future SOWs under this Agreement.

entries.suggestedChange: Redline Exhibit A rates for Senior Data Engineer, Data Engineer, and BI Developer to be no lower than $85, $62, and $58 per hour respectively.
entries.impact: Collides with crestline MFN pricing commitment, which is live until 31 July 2027.
